chunks.text: Package leaflet: Information for the user Fictamol 250 mg film-coated tablets What is in this leaflet

chunks.section_title: What it is and what it is used for
chunks.text: Fictamol is a pain reliever. It is used to treat mild to moderate pain such as headache and toothache, and to reduce fever.

Do not take Fictamol if you are allergic to the active substance or to any of the other ingredients. Talk to your pharmacist before taking Fictamol if you have liver problems or drink large amounts of alcohol. Other medicines and Fictamol: tell your pharmacist if you are taking blood thinners such as warfarin. Driving and using machines: Fictamol has no influence on the ability to drive.
Adults and adolescents over 12 years: take 1 to 2 tablets with water every 6 hours as needed. Do not take more than 8 tablets in 24 hours. Do not use for more than 3 days without talking to a doctor.

Like all medicines, Fictamol can cause side effects, although not everybody gets them. Uncommon side effects: nausea and stomach pain. Rare side effects: skin rash and itching. Stop taking Fictamol and see a doctor if you get a skin rash.
Store below 25 degrees Celsius in the original package to protect from moisture. Keep out of the sight and reach of children.

chunks.section_title: Contents of the pack and other information
chunks.text: Each tablet contains 250 mg of fictamol. The other ingredients are maize starch and magnesium stearate. Packs of 20 tablets.
Package leaflet: Information for the user Sampleastine 10 mg tablets

chunks.section_title: What it is and what it is used for
chunks.text: Sampleastine is an antihistamine. It relieves the symptoms of hay fever, such as sneezing, a runny nose and itchy eyes.
Sampleastine may make you drowsy. Avoid drinking alcohol while taking this medicine. Driving and using machines: do not drive or operate machines if you feel sleepy.
Adults: take one tablet once a day. Children under 6 years should not take these tablets.
Common side effects: drowsiness, dry mouth and tiredness.
Store in a dry place below 25 degrees Celsius.

chunks.section_title: Contents of the pack and other information
chunks.text: Each tablet contains 10 mg of sampleastine. The tablets are round and white. Packs of 7 and 30 tablets.
Package leaflet: Information for the patient Testoprazole 20 mg gastro-resistant capsules

chunks.section_title: What it is and what it is used for
chunks.text: Testoprazole reduces the amount of acid made in the stomach. It is used to treat heartburn and acid reflux in adults.

Do not take Testoprazole if you are allergic to it. Tell your doctor if you have severe kidney disease. Pregnancy and breast-feeding: ask your doctor or pharmacist for advice before taking this medicine. Other medicines: Testoprazole may change how the body absorbs iron supplements.
The usual dose is one capsule once a day before breakfast. Swallow the capsule whole with half a glass of water. Do not chew or crush it.
Common side effects: headache, diarrhoea and flatulence. Rare side effects: blurred vision and hair loss.
Do not store above 30 degrees Celsius. Keep the bottle tightly closed.

chunks.section_title: Contents of the pack and other information
chunks.text: The capsules are white and yellow. Packs of 14 and 28 capsules.
